items.title: Tor amplitude in a bounded interval is equivalent to representability by a bounded complex of flat modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises tor amplitude in a bounded interval through representability by a bounded complex of flat modules on a ringed site (statement lines 12431-12442). The proof (proof lines 12444-12469) reads one implication off the flat representative, reduces the other to a bounded above flat representative by induction using flatness of kernels of surjections of flat modules, and finishes by truncating below and applying the last-one-flat criterion. H2: two truncation steps with a flatness input, written out.
